Lae'zel prefers direct (if sometimes rude and harsh) approaches in interacting with almost everyone around, especially non-gith.

She approves of righteous authority, firm-handed leadership and domination, bravery and self-denial in the name of common good. She prefers the most direct path to ridding herself, and by extension the party, of the tadpole infection, more so that she knows the one and only solution to this problem. Lastly, when proving more effective, Lae'zel approves of choosing cool-minded and practical options over ones from emotions and passions.

The story and dialogue choices listed on this page raise  Lae'zel's approval.

All entries for approval values shown on this page come directly from official in-game dialogue files as of Patch 7. However, in any given playthrough, specific approval changes may not trigger for several reasons, primarily among them: game bugs[note 1], installed mods, or the companion character already being at maximum approval.

For more information about the approval system, see Approval.

Act One

Locations

Ravaged Beach and Roadside Cliffs[note 2]

  • When recruiting Astarion, accept his apologies and say you would have done the same (+1) ( The Dark Urge characters have additional, unique line)
  • Refuse to dismiss Lae'zel from your party when Shadowheart demands it as a condition for recruiting her (+5)
    • Fail the roll to convince Shadowheart when she refuses to be recruited (+5)
  • Speaking to Gimblebock near Chapel Entrance, choose to attack the gang (+1)

Note: Approval can only be gained if you approach by the front entrance or come out from the crypt. If you approach from the back entrance (east of where you recruit Lae'zel), you will not gain approval.

  • Playing as  The Dark Urge, tear off Gale's hand during his potential recruitment scene (+1)


Emerald Grove

In The Hollow:

  • In the argument between Aradin and Zevlor when you first enter, pass a passive  Insight check to realize one of them is about to lose their temper, then successfully punch either of them (+1)
  • Refuse to help Zevlor convince Kagha to let the tieflings stay (+1) ( The Dark Urge characters have unique replacement line)
  • Scold Elegis for being scared of a few goblins (+1) ( Githyanki characters have unique line here)
    • OR, as a  Fighter, say their position favours the defender, then tell her to get to digging their own graves (+1)
  • Playing as a  Githyanki, tell Lakrissa that there's no glory in defeat (+1)
  • While Arka is still mourning over Kanon's body, tell her to seek vengeance over his death (+1) (available and grants approval, too, if Memnos is also dead;  The Dark Urge characters have unique lines but gain approval only if Memnos died)
  • Tell the tielfling kids trained by Asharak that they are going to die (+1)
    • OR, Playing as Wyll origin, tell Asharak he'll get them all killed (+1)
  • Assist Guex in training (using  Athletics,  Insight,  Detect Thoughts, or unique  Githyanki,  Barbarian,  Monk,  Half-Orc,  Fighter, or Wyll origin lines) (+1) (Works, too, if the character is  disguised as a githyanki)
    • Tell Guex not to shout out his moves after helping him train (+1)
  •  Tell Pandirna to hush or you will snap her neck (+1) (Available for all classes except  Barbarian)

Note: You do not have to pass the check to gain the approval, but she will call for guards if you fail

  • While talking to/trading with Mattis, catch Silfy trying to pickpocket you and attempt to  grab her by the hand (+1)

Note: You do not have to pass the check to gain the approval

  • When Barth confronts Meli about the locket, tell the boy to return it, because "There's already one thief to bury today." (+1) (Available for all classes except  Barbarian)

Note: This line is available only if Arabella has died

  • Playing as a  Lolth-Sworn Drow, talking to Mol after having messed with one of her friends, threaten to tear her spine out (+1)
    • If confronting Mol about your stolen belongings,  threaten to rip her tail off (+1) (Available for all classes except  Barbarian)

Note: You do not have to pass the check to gain the approval

  • Talk to Zevlor after defeating the goblin leaders (+10)
  • After helping Minthara to slaughter the Grove, instigate a fight with her (+1) ( Elf and  Lolth-Sworn Drow characters have unique lines here)

In the Sacred Pool and druid caves:

  • Choose to do nothing when Kagha is threatening Arabella (+1)
    • After resolving Arabella's fate, speak to Kagha and praise her for protecting her own (+1) ( Drow characters have unique version of conversation)
    • If Arabella has died, speak to Rath and blame the child (+1)
  • Swear to Nettie that you will take the wyvern poison if you start turning (+1) ( Clerics characters have unique lines here)
    • Attack her after she scratches any party member with a deadly briar (no need to kill her) (+1)
  • Playing as a  Bard, talk to the squirrels listening to Alfira and first hush them not to ruin the song, then choose to sing along with them (+1) (Requires  Speak with Animals)
    • Take Alfira's lute out of her hands and smash it (+1)

Note: You do not have to pass the Dexterity check to gain the approval

Sunlit Wetlands/Putrid Bog

  • When find Demir and Johl arguing with Auntie Ethel, say that you aren't getting involved OR that this has nothing to do with you (+1) (either option, but both lead to Ethel killing the brothers on the spot)
  • If the brothers survive their conversation with Ethel, tell them they're on their own (+1)
    • OR, playing as a  Ranger,  Sorcerer, or  Wizard, give your class-specific response, then tell them to trust a more experienced soul (+1)
  • Betray Astarion's identity to Gandrel in the first conversation where it is revealed that Gandrel is hunting him(+1)[note 3]
  • Drink from the well outside the Riverside Teahouse (+1)
  • Chasing after Auntie Ethel in her lair, speak to Lorin and ROAR at him (+1)
  •  Intimidate the Gnarled Door to let you in (+1) ( Barbarians and  The Dark Urge have unique replacement lines; the  Barbarian line does not grant approval, but  The Dark Urge line does)

Note: You do not have to pass the check to gain the approval

  • If Auntie Ethel is brought to low HP and tries to surrender,  Deceive or  Intimidate her into handing over both Mayrina and the fey hair (+5) ( Barbarians,  Berserkers, and  Fighters have unique replacement lines)
    • OR Say that the best solution is a dead hag (+1) ( Clerics,  Druids,  Githyanki,  Monks,  Paladins, and  Rangers have unique lines)

Forest, Owlbear Nest and Blighted Village

  • Tell Brynna and Andrick to avenge Edowin (+1)
    • OR Tell them you're a survivor of the crash (+1) (starts combat with both)
  • Choose to attack the Mother Owlbear (+1)
    • OR Fail the  Performance check to scare her away (+1) ( Barbarian characters have unique line)
    • OR Pass the  Animal Handling check to determine that she is protecting the Owlbear Cub, then move toward the cub anyway (+1)
    • OR, If using  Speak with Animals, move closer to the mother, ask what she's waiting for, then fail either the  Intimidation or  Persuasion checks. (+1) ( Barbarian,  Berserker,  Druid and  Ranger characters have unique lines)
  • After killing the Mother Owlbear, kill the cub as well (+1)
  • Fail any of the checks to convince Shadowheart it's okay to loot the Selûnite chest (+1) ( Barbarians and  Clerics of evil deities have unique checks)
    • OR, Playing as a  Cleric of  Selûne, rebuke Shadowheart for speaking ill of your goddess (+1) (Only available if you already know Shadowheart worships  Shar)
    • OR, if it is revealed during this conversation that Shadowheart worships  Shar, tell her you can't trust her (+5)

In the Blighted Village:

  • Gain entrance to the village by  Intimidating the goblin guard at the southern gate (+1) (Available for all classes except  Barbarian)

Note: You do not have to pass the check to gain the approval

  • In dialogue with Fezzerk, choose "Attack the goblins" (+1)

Note: Other dialogue choices that initiate combat will not grant approval

  • If Fezzerk is brought to low HP and tries to surrender, deliver the final blow (+1)

Note:  Barbarians must first pass a  Wisdom check to resist killing him

  • Drop and prepare to destroy the Necromancy of Thay in the Apothecary's Cellar (+1)

Goblin Camp

At the front gate:

  • Fling worg dung at Sentinel Olak (+1) (triggers a fight with gate guards if check is successful)

Note: Any approval at the front gate is unavailable if Sazza is with you, as it bypasses this conversation. You do not have to pass the  Athletics check to gain the approval, and you may not want to in order to get the next approval too

  • If you failed the check, wink and fling dung at all other guards (+1) (also triggers fight)

In the outer camp:

  • Tell Tracker Grikka that you will get answers from the prisoner (+1)
  • Yell, "Boo, get off the stage!" at Volo as he performs (+1)
  • When playing chicken-chasing with Dishevelled Chicken:
    • Using  Speak with Animals,  persuade her to attack goblins (+1) (Available for all classes except  Barbarian and  Druid)
    • OR, Playing as a  Druid,  intimidate her to do it (+1)
    • Tell her to run to the finish posts, OR Order to shut up and play (+1) (either option)
    • Without  Speak with Animals,  urge her to attack the goblins (+1)
    • OR, playing as a  Druid,  shoo her towards the posts (+1)

Note: You do not have to pass any of the checks to gain the approval, but you must be interacting with the Dishevelled Chicken; no approval is available with the Owlbear Cub


Talking to Crusher:

  • When Crusher tells you to kiss his foot, tell him you'd sooner spit in his face, then double down on it when he questions you (+1)
    • OR pass the  Intimidation check telling him to kiss your feet instead (which he still won't do at this stage) (+1) ( Barbarians have unique replacement check)
    • Finally, make Crusher kneel and kiss your foot by passing another  Intimidation check OR using  Illithid Persuasion OR using  Detect Thoughts then saying you'll let his boss know of his plans.(+1) ( Barbarians have unique replacement  Intimidation check)
  • If Crusher starts a fight, make him kiss your foot after defeating him (+1)
    • After defeating Crusher (or after having him kiss your foot), finish him (+1) (makes the whole camp hostile)

In the Shattered Sanctum:

  • When stopped by Warrior Trinzas when coming in through the main entrance, choose to attack her first (+1) (starts a fight with Sanctum guards)
    • OR, if you have already swept the festival area of goblins, tell her the ruckus was the sound of her friends dying (+1)

Note: Any approval from Trinzas is unavailable if Sazza is with you, as it bypasses this conversation

  • If it comes out when entering that Shadowheart is a follower of  Shar, say you didn't agree to join up with a Sharran, then tell her to leave (+5)
  • If Wyll is present when you interact with Priestess Gut in the throne room, nod to him (+1)
    • If Wyll is NOT present, tell her you'll spill her guts (+1) (Similar  Paladin options will not grant approval)
    • If talking to Gut a second time in the throne room, say you're ready to kill her (+1) (Replacement  Paladin line WILL grant approval in this conversation)
  • If you cleared out the Zhentarim Hideout, tell Roah Moonglow you killed her friends (+1)

Note: You must pass the passive  History check to realize she is Zhentarim in order to have this dialogue option

  • Choose any of the options to attack Dror Ragzlin EXCEPT for the below: (+1)
    • When he has successfully cast  Speak with Dead but hasn't started asking questions yet
    • After using  Speak with Dead yourself and asking your first question but before your second or third question
    • When playing as a  Githyanki, after he makes the connection between the Mysterious Artefact and your race
  • Promise Minthara to get information from the captive (+1) ( Half-Orcs have unique replacement line)
  • As a  Drow, tell Torturer Spike that you get results (+1) ( Drow cannot obtain any additional approval points in this conversation)
    • For any other race, ask to have a chance to torture Liam (+1) ( The Dark Urge has unique replacement lines for this and all below options in this conversation)
    • Then either crush Liam's groin OR burn his thigh (+1)
    • Next, either break his kneecap OR pull off his toenail (+1)

Note: Breaking the kneecap will only grant approval if you crushed his groin; pulling the toenail will grant approval regardless of the previous choice

  • Tell Brakkal (the Maglubiyet devotee in the cage) that the gods are fickle (+1) (Available to all classes except  Cleric)
    • OR, Playing as a  Githyanki, say that your people build cities on the corpses of gods OR that you find Faerûn's gods tiresome (+1)
  • Tell Minthara that Sazza was too stupid to understand you prior (+1)
    • OR, Playing as a  Lolth-Sworn Drow, tell Sazza she should have seen a superior in you at once (+1)

Note: Sazza must be freed from the cage in Emerald Grove

Underdark and Grymforge

  • After defeating the duergar, refuse to help Glut usurp the circle OR say you'll kill it instead (+1) (either option brings equal approval and immediately starts fight with Glut)
  • In the Festering Cove, call BOOOAL a fake god and tell him you will kill him (+1)
  • Push Corsair Greymon off of the boat on your first voyage to Grymforge (+5)
  • Upon arriving to Grymforge, tell Morghal and Orgarth that them keeping slaves is not a problem for you, and that you'll just kill them (+1) (starts a fight with the duergar, both Clan Flameshade and Absolute followers)

Dealing with Ward Magmar:

    • Ask him how to get a slave of your own (+1)
    • Playing as a  Drow or as a  Githyanki, tell Magmar that he is squandering his slave (+1)
    • Try to take the elevator, then tell Magmar that saving Nere is a distraction (+1)
    • Tell him that Moonrise Towers hold the answers you need (+1)
    • After killing Magmar and Pistle, tell Skickpit to use the elevator to surface (+1) (further options to convince him won't bring more approval)
  • Looking at skeletal remains of Dark Justiciars, say "Better off dead" OR "Die in filth" (+1) (either option)
  •  Convince the Deep Rothé to attack the duergar (+1)
  • Provoke a fight against Elder Brithvar by either taunting him to try and take your gold OR suggesting to rat him out to Sergeant Thrinn about his conspiracy against Nere (+1)
    • After finding Philomeen (and letting her go away), talk to Lunkbug and mention she wants Laridda to move on, or tell Laridda directly (+1)
  • After saving Nere, tell him to finish the slaves, OR choose to say nothing (+1) (either option)
    • Side with Brithvar when confronting Nere (+1)
  • If you killed the duergar (both rebels and Absolutists) before freeing Nere, plant a thought in the drow's mind about freeing the gnome slaves (+1)

The Risen Road and Zhentarim Hideout

  • Side with Karlach during Wyll's confrontation with her and recruit Karlach (+2)
  • At the tollhouse, agree to hunt the monster (i.e. Karlach) for Anders (+1)
    • Tell the trader Cyrel that you'll take the supplies and everything else she owns (+1) (starts the fight with the whole group)
    • Talking to Anders with Karlach in your party, say you believe her and not him (+1)
  • Tell Rugan that you are here for the cargo, not to rescue him (+1)
  • Save Rugan, then  convince him to surrender the cargo OR provoke a fight with him (+1)
    • If you fail the  Intimidation check, say you can harm him no less worse than gnolls would have (+1) (makes him hostile)

In the Zhentarim Hideout:

  • Successfully  Intimidate the guard Salazon to let you go through the hatch to the hideout (+1)
  • Purchasing Oskar Fevras,  intimidate or  persuade Brem to lower the price (+1)
    • OR Make him let Oskar go for free, using any check-based option (+1)
    • After purchasing the artist, speak to the him and call him a slave twice (+1)

Mountain Pass, Rosymorn Monastery Trail and Crèche Y'llek [note 4]

  • Playing as a  Githyanki, tell Ellyka that githyanki patrol means nothing to you (+1)
    • OR, Being  disguised as a githyanki, tell her you're actually not OR that she is safe (+1) (either option)
  • Tell Lady Esther that her proposal to Steal a Githyanki Egg is revolting, then attack her (+1)

Upon entering the Crèche:[note 4]

  • Let Lae'zel speak to Gish Far'aag for the group (+1)
    • OR, if you met Voss at the Mountain Pass, show her the Mysterious Artefact (+1) ( Githyanki characters have the additional option to instead  persuade her to not need to see the artefact)
  • If entering through the back entrance and the Mountain Pass encounter ended peacefully, tell G'r'ath that "Captain" Voss won't be happy if you're killed (+2)
    • OR, if playing as a  Githyanki, say you have Kith'rak Voss's weapon (+1) (the above, higher approval option is unavilable to  Githyanki)
    • OR say you're infected, then say you have Voss's weapon (+1) (this option is available whether the Mountain Pass encounter ended peacefully or not, as long as it did take place)
    • OR, if you defeated the githyanki patrol at the Mountain Pass,  lie that you're working for Voss (+1)

Note: None of the back entrance approval gains are available if the Mountain Pass encounter was skipped

At the Infirmary:

  • Let Lae'zel speak for the group when talking to Ghustil Stornugoss (+1)
  • Approach the zaith'isk (+5)
    • Demand to use the zaith'isk first, convincing the githyanki by any means (+8)
    • Step away from the zaith'isk, then interact with it again (+5) (only grants approval if Stornugoss is alive)
    • Endure three phases of zaith'isk purification by any means (+1) (each phase, up to +3 total)
  • Let Lae'zel use the zaith'isk (+10), and then either:
    • Convince her that the device kills instead of curing (+1)

Note: To do this, succeed a passive  DC 14 Perception Check, then succeed a  DC 30 Wisdom Check,  DC 30 Persuasion Check or  DC 30 History Check (the latter for  Githyanki only)

    • Let her proceed to the second phase (+1), then stop the purification (+1)

Note: To do this, succeed a  DC 21 Wisdom Check, and then  DC 21 Persuasion Check or  DC 30 Deception Check

    • Let her proceed to the third phase (+1) and endure it (+1)

Note: Letting Lae'zel to go through the whole "purification" process will permanently lower by 2 points her  Intelligence, then  Wisdom and  Constitution each, consequently

In the Classroom:

  • Offer to fight Youth Varrl when Sa'varsh Kethk asks for a challenger (+1) ( The Dark Urge has a similar, replacement line, but it does not grant approval)
    • OR, Playing as a  Githyanki, tell Kethk that he should kill Varrl himself if the youth won't fight (+1)
  • Once fighting Varrl, kill him (+1) ( The Dark Urge characters have two unique lines here, both granting approval)
  • After saving him from his teacher, use any skill-based option to convince Varrl to give you his book about Orpheus (+5) ( Githyanki characters have unique line here)
    • OR, Playing as a  Bard, pass a  Performance check (+5)

Note: If you fight Varrl and leave him knocked out, dialogue treats him has unconscious indefinitely, even if he is shown sitting up after a Long Rest, therefore, these points cannot be gained

At the Hatchery:

  • Successfully  persuade Varsh Ko'kuu to let you take the Githyanki Egg, then tell him:
    • That you'll take it to a better crèche OR That you'll raise it yourself (+1) (either option)
    • OR Use unique race-based option for a  Githyanki (+1)

In Captain's Quarters and Inquisitor's Chamber

  • Produce the Mysterious Artefact for Kith'rak Therezzyn (+1)
  • Playing as a  Githyanki, ask Ch'r'ai W'wargaz for a promotion from Vlaakith in return for the weapon (+1)

Note: This line can only be reached by asking what you'll get in return, which gives a disapproval point that balances the gain out

  • Show W'wargaz the artefact (+3)
    • OR Refuse to hand over the artefact and convince Lae'zel to trust you (Requires  DC 21 Persuasion Check) (+3)
    • OR Remind Lae'zel of the zaith'isk (if you've learned the truth about it while using) (+3)

Note: You can still produce the artifact after taking either of these options to gain a total of (+6)

  • Kneel before Vlaakith's projection (+3) ( Githyanki characters have unique line here.  The Dark Urge characters have unique lines available only if Lae'zel is not present)
  • If Lae'zel is not present, tell Vlaakith you're a friend who brought the artefact to her (+1) (Available to all races but  Githyanki)
    • Further in this version of the scene, rat Shadowheart out that it was she who stole the artefact (+1)

Note: The line is available only if Shadowheart is in the party and leads to an immediate Game Over

  • Accept Vlaakith's demands to kill the person inside the artefact without questioning her divinity (+10) ( Githyanki and Shadowheart origin have unique lines here, but the  Githyanki response does not give approval in the version of this scene where Lae'zel is present)
    • OR question why a god can't handle this herself, then say you spoke too hastily (+10)

Note: Lae'zel can still gain approval in the version of the scene where she is not present by moving close enough to the scene after it has already begun


Astral Plane[note 5]

  • Open your mind to Lae'zel after meeting with the Dream Guardian (+3)
    • OR  persuade her that W'wargaz is going to kill them all (+1)

Campsite and Conversations

Raphael's deal

  • When Raphael briefly takes you to the House of Hope, choose the lines:
    • "I need to think this over" (+1)
    • OR "You're mad if you think I'll make a deal with a devil" (+1) (Wyll origin has a unique replacement line)
    • OR "Then fix it. Or die by my hand!" (+1)

Camp interactions:

  • After Lae'zel describes the ceremorphosis process to you, say that you will find the cure (+3) (Unique lines for  Elf and  Dragonborn)
  • After finding out Halsin is missing from the Emerald Grove, ask her whether she's sure the crèche is the only way for a cure, then tell her that their information is valuable (+3)
  • In the conversation that takes place after your first use of  Illithid Persuasion, say that illithid powers to manipulate others can't be trusted even if they're useful (+1) (each origin character has a unique line)
  • Before the first visit of the Dream Guardian, when Lae'zel intends to kill everyone before they turn into mind flayers, talk her out of it (+5)
    • OR Ask her to give you the knife to end her first, then say you all still have time (+5)
  • After the first visit of the Dream Guardian, tell her that it should be ignored at all costs  +1
    • After the second Dream Guardian's visit, say you distrust the visitor, too  +1

Discussing githyanki customs after visiting the crèche:

  • After visiting the classroom, ask Lae'zel if all gith instructors are so brutal, then praise Lae'zel for killing her own classmates (+3) (Available to all races but  Githyanki)
  • After visiting the hatchery, comment on how there was only a single egg (+3) ( Githyanki have unique replacement line)

After visiting the Astral Plane in the crèche:

  • Ask Lae'zel if her show of faith will be enough (+3)
  • If Lae'zel was not present when visiting the Astral Plane, tell her Vlaakith has turned against her, then tell her about meeting the Dream Guardian (+3)

Note: There is an option to immediately tell her about the Dream Guardian, but only the option deeper into the conversation grnts approval

  • When filling Lae'zel in on what the Dream Guardian said, tell her you don't trust the Dream Guardian (+3)
    • OR, Playing as a  Githyanki, say you reject this abomination (+3)

If you destroyed the crèche with the Lathander’s Lance:

  • Speaking to Lae'zel afterwards (automated dialogue), say you should have been more careful (+1)
    • OR Say you feel sorry for destruction of the crèche (or ashamed, if playing as a  Githyanki) (+3)

Other companions and camp followers

  • Resurrect a companion with Withers's help (+1) (Works only the first time you do it)
  • At the very first night in the camp, snap at Shadowheart, saying, "Don't question me" (+1)
  • When Astarion tries to bite you, stake him. In the morning, tell others that he was a threat to all (+1)
  • Playing as Astarion origin, confess that you are a vampire and succeed a  Charisma check (+1)

Note: The approval is technically gained regardless of whether or not the check is passed, but failing gives an additional (-1), balancing it out. If your approval is between 0 and 20, no check is required

  • Whenever in Act One Lae'zel finds out you're a vampire, promise her to have no "githyanki meals" (+3)
  • If Wyll was recruited before Karlach but was not present when she was recruited, he confronts her at the camp the next long rest. Use any line to convince him to spare Karlach (+2) (any option that avoids combat; instigating a fight does not grant approval in this version of the scene)
    • If Wyll confronts Karlach at the camp (not being recruited yet), use any line to convince him to spare Karlach (+1)
    • OR Instigate fight with Wyll (+1) (either option, but only in this version of the scene)
  • Tell Mizora she's not leaving your camp alive during her first appearance there (+1)
    • OR, if you didn't kill her, tell Mizora not to lay a finger on Karlach (+1)
    • OR, Playing as Karlach origin, ask Mizora why doesn't she f*ck off (+1)
  • If you did not save Shadowheart on the Nautiloid, fail the roll to convince her to join the party OR choose to leave without recruiting the cleric (+1) (either option)
  • When Shadowheart comes to the camp all not herself, choose to attack her (+10)
  • OR,  persuade her to have a rest at the camp. On the next morning, say you were mistaken to keep her around (+5)

Note: This scene occurs only if you have missed all opportunities to recruit the cleric at the beginning of the game

  • If it comes out in camp that Shadowheart is a follower of  Shar, say you didn't agree to join up with a Sharran, then tell her to leave (+5)
    • Playing as a  Cleric of  Selûne, call  Shar an abomination before telling Shadowheart to leave (+5) (can be added to previous points)
  • After Shadowheart has been revealed to be a follower of  Shar, ask her to explain tenets of her faith to you, then say it sounds evil (+1)
  • When Lae'zel and Shadowheart have an argument over the Mysterious Artefact:
    • If Lae'zel attacks Shadowheart sneakily at night, choose to do nothing (+10) (Shadowheart dies)
    • If Shadowheart attacks sneakily at night, choose to attack Shadowheart (+10)
    • OR  persuade her to stop (+10)
    • OR, if that check is failed, side with Lae'zel (+10)
  • Come back to camp after successfully raiding the Emerald Grove with goblins  +5

Romance

  • Accept her offer to have sex in the future (+5)
    • Have sex with her when she visits you at night (+3)
